meta.title: Forty Tour
meta.description: A virtual 360° tour of the Forty 2 campus on the Oléron Island. Explore the campus and interact with different areas on your own.

parking.title: Free Parking
parking.description: Free 24/7 parking during your stay at the fort in case you arrive by car.

gaming.title: Gaming Room
gaming.description: The gaming room is open 24/7 and can always be used to watch movies or just play games, including videogames.

community.title: Community Building
community.description: Whether its karaoke at night, watching a movie or just a community event, this is the place they are usually at.

cluster.title: Clusters
cluster.description: The clusters are open at any time and ready if you decide to do some work.

refectory.title: Refectory
refectory.description: Refectory where meals are served 3 times per day.
